items.title: Reply with decision on deferred compensation (Entgeltumwandlung) offer
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Ihre Entscheidung bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum mit.
items.computation: The letter is dated Tue 11.05.2027 ('Briefdatum'). The 10-business-day period runs from this date under the contractual term 'ab dem Briefdatum'. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (11.05.) is not counted; counting starts 12.05.2027. 'Arbeitstage' are defined by the letter as Monday-Friday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting 10 such business days from 12.05.2027 (using NW public holidays, as the employee's region) lands on Wed 26.05.2027. That day is itself a business day (not a weekend or holiday), so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 26.05.2027.

warnings: This is an informational offer letter from the employer, not an authority decision, so it carries no legal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and no deemed-delivery rule applies; the 10-business-day deadline is purely contractual as stated by the employer.

The letter references an enclosed 'Angebot und Beitragsrechnung' (offer and contribution calculation) that was not included in the text provided, so the actual euro amount to be converted and the resulting employer top-up (15%) could not be captured as a numeric amount.
The sender's IBAN (DE04 3705 0198 0005 5566 00) is well-formed but this only confirms its format, not who owns the account; no payment is actually requested in this letter.
